use_cases: Animated text reveals for hero sections with staggered character, word, or line effects
Eye-catching typography animations for landing pages and marketing content
Scroll-triggered text animations for storytelling and narrative presentations
Dynamic entrance effects for headings, titles, and callouts
Interactive text displays with configurable blur, scale, and fade presets
ai_summary: A motion primitives text animation component that reveals text content with configurable presets including blur, scale, fade-in-blur, and slide effects. Supports per-character, per-word, or per-line animation granularity with staggered timing controls. Built on motion/react for smooth GPU-accelerated animations.
